slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: When the bot breaks
slides.subtitle: A live failure is often your best eval scenario.

slides.title: What happened
slides.body: The Telegram bot worked, then one query made the agent call the same search tool repeatedly.

slides.title: Good news
slides.body: That failure is now a concrete scenario, not a vague concern about agent reliability.

slides.title: Encode it
slides.body: Add a tool-call limit, graceful fallback, regression test, and eval scenario.

slides.title: Rule
slides.body: Every weird demo failure is a future test case.
